messages:
anya: Quick sync thread for the console analytics schema cutover. Keep it tight: no dashboard regressions, rollbackable, low index churn.
rohan: TL;DR plan?
anya: dual-write -> compact projection (shadow) -> staged canary -> cutover. Add safepoint and reconciliation steps.
mike: On dual-write stamp `ingest_version='v2-2024'` and write a tiny `route_hash`. Populating a narrow `ingest_projection` avoids JSON-heavy reads.
jess: Console: show a small "experimental data" badge when reading from v2; toggle behind feature-flag. Also an escalator to ping #support on 20% canary.
eva: Telemetry: emit per-route v1/v2 counts, mismatch_ratio, and `ingest_migration_toggle` events. Start deterministic sampling (hash(route_id)%100 < 1) but always include low-card routes.
rohan: Canary: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h. Abort if mismatch_ratio > 0.02 for routes >1k/day OR console query p95_new/p95_old > 1.25.
mike: To protect p99s maintain compact projection table with index on (route_id, day) and TTL. Sample index DDL in runbook: `CREATE INDEX ix_ingest_proj_route_day ON ingest_projection(route_id, day);`
anya: Rollback runbook steps: 1) flip read adapter to v1, 2) disable dual-write, 3) run reconciliation job, 4) notify teams. Include exact commands.
rohan: Example toggles for runbook: 
```
-- SQL
UPDATE feature_flags SET value='v1-only' WHERE key='console.ingest.read_mode';
-- admin
POST /admin/feature-toggles/console-ingest?mode=v1-only
```
jess: I'll add dashboard card: v1_count, v2_count, mismatch_ratio, p50/p95 latency delta and make it a canary gate.
eva: I'll implement mismatch metric + sampling config and emit toggle telemetry on rollbacks. Also log full diffs for ~50 random routes/day for manual auditing.
sre-bot: automated: schedule shadow-write at 2024-05-03T02:00Z when flags enabled :gear:
rohan: Add safepoint export of routing join keys before cutover to speed reconciliation. Suggest: `pg_dump --table=routing_keys --data-only --file=safepoint_$(date +%s).sql`.
mike: I'll prototype projection DDL and add index DDL to the runbook PR. Keep projection columns minimal to reduce I/O.
anya: I'll author the runbook PR and coordinate canary windows with SRE. Owners: Jess UI, Eva telemetry/ingest, Mike projection/index, Rohan rollout controller. Plan to enable dual-write Tue AM pending approvals.
ingest-bot: noted: will emit more logs when sampling config updated.
anya: Thanks all, I'll link the PR here when ready. Closing thread.
